sessions.phase_label: Qualification test and initial revision proposals
Editorial scope definition and contract clarification
Manuscript execution, editorial review, and project termination

requirements.title: Leadership-Focused Pre-Interview Preparation Chapter
requirements.definition: Provide a concise non-question-and-answer chapter or checklist covering pre-interview preparation specifically for experienced and leadership-level candidates.
requirements.boundary_note: This chapter can be authored, reviewed, or revised independently of the four other proposed chapters; its leadership-specific focus and concise basic-chapter format remain attributes of this chapter.

requirements.title: AI Interview Preparation Chapter
requirements.definition: Provide the mandatory concise chapter explaining the use of AI prompts, techniques, and tools for interview preparation.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently mandatory chapter and is separate from the constraint governing whether AI may be used to create the manuscript.

requirements.title: Candidate Questions for Interviewers Chapter
requirements.definition: Provide a question-and-answer chapter covering useful questions that leadership candidates can ask interviewers.
requirements.boundary_note: The chapter has its own subject matter and question set and can be revised independently of the first-time-leader and remote or hybrid chapters.

requirements.title: First-Time Leader Questions Chapter
requirements.definition: Provide a question-and-answer chapter specifically addressing candidates transitioning into leadership for the first time.
requirements.boundary_note: First-time leadership is a distinct reader context with independently selectable questions and answers, rather than an attribute of the other new chapters.

requirements.title: Remote and Hybrid Leadership Questions Chapter
requirements.definition: Provide a question-and-answer chapter covering leadership interviews for remote and hybrid working environments.
requirements.boundary_note: Remote and hybrid leadership has a distinct acceptance topic and question set and can evolve separately from the other proposed chapters.

requirements.title: Existing Question Set Curation
requirements.definition: Review the existing 720 questions and recommend removal, addition, or rewording of individual questions to keep the edition current, relevant, and non-duplicative.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement governs individual-question selection and wording; restructuring whole categories or chapters and formatting the resulting answers are independently actionable behaviors.

requirements.title: Question Category and Chapter Structure Curation
requirements.definition: Review the existing organizational structure and recommend merging, removing, or introducing question categories or chapters where needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Category and chapter restructuring can be accepted or rejected independently of individual question edits and therefore remains separate from question-level curation.

requirements.title: Layered Answer Structure
requirements.definition: Structure each applicable question answer with mandatory framing guidance and a sample answer, integrating answer frameworks into the guidance and adding interviewer intent or common mistakes where useful.
requirements.boundary_note: The required and optional layers are attributes of one answer-format mechanism; they should not be split into separate Requirements, but the mechanism is independent of which questions or categories are retained.

requirements.title: Editorial Approval Before Content Changes
requirements.definition: Treat additions, removals, mergers, and rewording proposals as subject to editorial-team review before they are incorporated as final manuscript changes.
requirements.boundary_note: This approval condition governs when proposed edits become final and can remain unchanged even if the substantive question or category rules are modified.

requirements.title: Integrated International Leadership Perspective
requirements.definition: Integrate international differences throughout the existing material rather than creating a separate global chapter, with an opening note describing the primary market focus and relevant country-specific guidance.
requirements.boundary_note: Placement, market focus, and country examples are attributes of one cross-book localization mechanism; this Requirement is independent of the existence of any particular new chapter.

requirements.title: Finished Companion Learning Assets
requirements.definition: Deliver the selected non-video companion learning resources as finished, practically usable products that support readers who do not consume the book cover-to-cover.
requirements.boundary_note: The exact asset selection remains open, but the delivery expectation for selected ordinary companion resources is distinct from the special rules for videos and templates.

requirements.title: Companion Video Scripts
requirements.definition: Supply scripts for selected companion videos while leaving video recording and production to the editorial team.
requirements.boundary_note: Video scripting has a different deliverable boundary from finished non-video assets because recording is explicitly excluded from the author's responsibility.

requirements.title: Production-Ready Companion Templates
requirements.definition: Develop selected companion templates with enough completeness and specificity for the production team to reproduce the intended final resource.
requirements.boundary_note: Template completeness can be evaluated independently of video scripts and other finished companion assets, so it is retained as a separate deliverable behavior.

requirements.title: Complete Manuscript Word Ceiling
requirements.definition: Keep the completed book at or below the overall 110,000-word limit while planning revisions and new material around the available space.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the cap for the entire book and is distinct from any contractual word count assigned specifically to newly authored or revised material.

requirements.title: Contracted Revision Word Count
requirements.definition: Use 24,000 words as the corrected agreement length for the contracted authored material, subject to clarification of its exact relationship to the chapter and revision allocations.
requirements.boundary_note: The source explicitly distinguishes the corrected 24,000-word agreement figure from the 74,000-word existing baseline and 110,000-word total cap, but does not fully define which authored sections consume the 24,000 words.

requirements.title: Manuscript Originality and Permitted AI Assistance
requirements.definition: Ensure the final manuscript reflects the author's original work and professional judgment, with AI assistance limited to permitted support activities such as spelling, grammar, research, outlining, translation, and editorial support.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a substantive manuscript-quality constraint revealed by the rejection evidence, not a generic testing Requirement or a duplicate of the AI interview-preparation chapter.

requirements.title: Authoritative Manuscript Editing Workflow
requirements.definition: Make all actual manuscript edits in the designated Google Doc using suggestion mode and appropriate editorial comments, while treating downloadable files as references only.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement concerns the authoritative editable artifact and edit-recording method; it is separate from substantive rules about which questions should be changed.

The corrected 24,000-word agreement length is distinguished from the 74,000-word baseline and 110,000-word total ceiling, but its exact allocation across five new chapters and existing-content revisions remains unclear.
The companion-resource delivery formats are defined, but the final set of required checklists, prompts, mock interviews, videos, templates, resume materials, or other assets is not finalized.
